title: Electrical Safety and Digital Multimeter Use

objectives.statement: Given a low-voltage trainer, identify electrical hazards and establish a safe measurement condition before connecting a meter.
Select the correct meter function, range, lead ports, and connection method for voltage, resistance, and current.
Measure and record source voltage, component resistance, and circuit current within the trainer tolerance.

lectures.title: Energy sources, de-energization, meter categories, and lead inspection
Voltage, resistance, and current measurement relationships

demonstrations.title: Live-dead-live meter verification on an isolated low-voltage trainer
Parallel voltage and series current connections

labs.title: Meter inspection and setup
procedure: Inspect the trainer, meter body, fuse rating, and leads before use.
Identify the expected quantity and energy state before choosing a function.
Place leads in the correct ports and state how the meter will connect.
Prove meter operation on the trainer check point before and after the measurement.
deliverables: Completed pre-use inspection and measurement setup checklist.
safety_notes: Use only the current-limited 24 V DC trainer.
De-energize before resistance measurements or lead-port changes.
Do not place a meter configured for current directly across the source.

labs.title: Measure electrical quantities
procedure: Measure source voltage with the meter connected in parallel.
De-energize and isolate the load before measuring its resistance.
Reconfigure the circuit and meter to measure current in series.
Compare each result with the expected range and resolve any discrepancy.
deliverables: Measurement table containing expected values, measured values, units, and tolerance decisions.
safety_notes: Confirm lead location and function selection before energizing.
Return the current lead to the voltage-resistance port after use.

assessments.title: Measurement safety briefing
assessments.description: Learner explains the energy state, connection method, meter setup, and stop-work conditions before making a measurement.

assessments.title: Digital multimeter practical
assessments.description: Learner safely completes voltage, resistance, and current measurements and evaluates each result against the stated tolerance.

required_resources: CAT-rated digital multimeter with fused current input
